headline: HHS finalizes HIPAA update on patient record access
pages: The Department of Health and Human Services has issued a long-awaited update to the HIPAA privacy rule, first proposed in January 2021, STAT reported Tuesday. The final rule cuts the maximum time that covered entities have to respond to patient requests for their records from 30 days to 15. It also bars unreasonable identity-proof requirements for patients seeking their own information. The rule sets standards for what it calls personal health applications, a newly defined category that can include wellness apps and fitness-tracker tools. The rest of STAT's report is behind a paywall, so further details are not covered here.

The change matters because it is meant to make it easier for patients to get their records and share them with apps they choose.
Source: STAT
